image.subject: two elderly sisters in plain wool cloaks and caps standing among gnarled apple trees in a colonial orchard at dusk, hands resting on the bark

storyboard.claim: The sisters are the orchard's spirits, keeping the trees alive.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two old women among apple trees, hands on bark.
storyboard.addedInformation: Mythic framing: bound to the trees.

storyboard.claim: By the 1820s or 1830s even the dryads die.
storyboard.addedInformation: The time frame of the sisters' end.

image.subject: an empty yellow clapboard farmhouse in a colonial New England orchard, open door, bare floorboards visible, no people, late autumn light

storyboard.claim: The yellow house is found empty, no finale.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the result of the sisters' disappearance.

image.subject: dark spruce and birch saplings pushing into the neat edge of an old apple orchard, wooden fence leaning, early morning mist, colonial New England

storyboard.claim: The forest encroaches on the orchard edges.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Saplings and brush advancing on orchard rows.

image.subject: a worn leather-bound town ledger lying open on a wooden table with faded handwriting, a quill beside it, candlelight, colonial era

storyboard.claim: The sisters fade into the footnotes of local history.
The dirt always wins; the place, not the people, is the true protagonist.

image.subject: goldenrod and brambles creeping over a collapsed fieldstone wall in an empty New England meadow, soft late-summer light

storyboard.claim: Goldenrod and brambles creep over the stone walls.
Can art capture the essence of the wilderness, or only mirror the artist's ego?

image.subject: a lone figure on a narrow dirt road walking toward a yellow farmhouse standing in a wild overgrown meadow, wooded hills behind, grey dawn

storyboard.claim: Someone new is lured into the land's orbit.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Lone figure approaching the old house.

image.subject: a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg sitting before a painter's easel in a dim room, face gaunt and impossibly pale, brush in hand

storyboard.claim: Meet William, a pale landscape painter.

image.subject: close portrait of a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg, hollow cheeks, sunken eyes, shivering in a cold room, breath visible

storyboard.claim: He is dangerously emaciated and sick.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Close portrait, hollow cheeks, visible breath.

image.subject: a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg in a wooden chair in a dusty freezing room of an old colonial house, heavy fur blanket over his shoulders, frost on the window

storyboard.claim: He sits wrapped in a bearskin blanket in the abandoned house.
storyboard.concreteVisual: William in fur blanket in a cold dusty room.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Places him in the yellow house.

image.subject: rows of glass jars filled with dead insects on a wooden shelf, mouse droppings on the dusty floorboards, a canvas on an easel in the background

storyboard.claim: He collects dead insects and paints obsessively amid mouse droppings.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Shelf of insect jars and dusty floor.

storyboard.claim: The sensory details of William's existence are suffocating.

image.subject: smoke and black soot pouring back into a dim room from a blocked fieldstone fireplace, a pale man coughing in the haze, colonial interior

storyboard.claim: Soot backs up from a blocked fieldstone chimney.

image.subject: close-up of a heavy iron leg brace strapped to a man's thin leg beneath a wooden chair, boot on a bare plank floor, colonial era

storyboard.claim: The iron brace scrapes whenever he shifts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Iron brace on his leg by the chair.

image.subject: a sickly translucent pale hand resting on top of a heavy dark fur blanket, blue veins visible, dim window light

storyboard.claim: His translucent pale hand rests outside the blanket.

image.subject: a pale hand on a dark fur blanket with a single bright red spot of color in sharp focus, shallow depth of field

storyboard.claim: Against the pale hand, a shocking red appears.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Pale hand with a red dot.

image.subject: two bright red ladybugs crawling across the back of a thin pale hand, macro photograph, dark fur blanket behind

storyboard.claim: Two ladybugs crawl across his hand as he wastes away.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two red ladybugs on a pale hand.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The payoff of the red detail.

storyboard.claim: He wastes away trying to capture life; it is remarkably relevant today.
We use nature as a blank passive screen for our desires and need for control.

image.subject: a hiker posing with arms outstretched in front of a majestic snowy mountain range, modern jacket, golden hour, photographed as if for a personal brand

storyboard.claim: Nature as an aesthetic backdrop for a personal brand.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Posing person before a mountain vista.

image.subject: a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg looking out a frosted window of an old house toward a pristine snowy forest, a distant grey town on the far horizon

storyboard.claim: He believes he escapes Boston to find truth in the forest.
storyboard.concreteVisual: William at the window facing the forest.

storyboard.claim: His artistic ambition is very specific.

image.subject: a 19th century study with a wooden desk, stacked leatherbound books, an oil lamp and a window onto dark woods

storyboard.claim: His ambition ties to 19th-century philosophy.
Emerson and Thoreau argue the divine lives in nature.
storyboard.onScreenText: THE DIVINE CAN BE FOUND IN NATURE

image.subject: a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg writing a letter by candlelight at a rough wooden table, ink pot and sheets of paper, a half-finished painting behind

storyboard.claim: He writes a desperate manifesto to his friend Nash.
storyboard.concreteVisual: William writing at a candlelit table.

image.subject: an ornate gilt-framed 19th century romantic landscape painting hanging on a wall, a tiny human figure standing at the center of a vast valley

storyboard.claim: He is exhausted by landscapes with the human at the center.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Grand landscape painting with human figure.

storyboard.claim: He wants to paint beast as seen by beast, tree as seen by tree.
storyboard.onScreenText: BEAST AS SEEN BY BEAST, TREE AS SEEN BY TREE

image.subject: a painting of a thick pine forest on an easel with a painter's pale hand smearing the wet paint, the dark canvas swallowing his sleeve

storyboard.claim: He wants to dissolve his identity and disability into the landscape.

image.subject: a bare rectangular wooden canvas frame held up before a snowy forest view, the frame cutting out part of the trees, winter light

storyboard.claim: Composition decides what stays in the frame.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Empty frame held up to a forest.
storyboard.addedInformation: Choosing what is in or out.

image.subject: extreme close-up of a human eye reflecting a tiny window and a forest, pale skin, winter light

storyboard.claim: He cannot escape his own human eye.
The failure is more selfish than a philosophical puzzle; the narrator rejects the noble framing.

image.subject: a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg turned away from an easel, staring blankly out a frosted window at the dark woods, unfinished canvas behind him

storyboard.claim: William isn't truly seeking spiritual dissolution.
storyboard.concreteVisual: William staring away from his canvas.

image.subject: a pale emaciated man in his thirties, wrapped in a heavy bearskin blanket, an iron brace on his bad leg pressing his bare palm against the rough bark of a pine tree in a snowy forest, eyes closed, longing expression

storyboard.claim: He uses the woods as an emotional and sexual substitute.
storyboard.concreteVisual: William pressing his hand against a tree.
